subject: Confirming monthly spend band & PO thresholds — Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call summary + ask: monthly spend band & PO threshold

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and one small ask to align procurement on our side before I put a formal estimate in HubSpot:

- Expected token volume: ~300M tokens/month (mostly generation; peaks to ~500M during campaign spikes).
- Target unit economics: ~ $0.80–$1.20 per 1M tokens (net after any commitment discounts).
- Desired monthly spend band (range for procurement): $8k–$15k to start, scale to $30k–$60k in Q3 if adoption goes as discussed.
- Preferred contract procurement threshold: PO required for spend > $50k/mo; otherwise we can accept card or standard managed invoice terms.

Can you confirm:
1) The monthly spend band above is within the budget envelope you discussed with finance?
2) Does Acme require a single annual PO for committed spend, or monthly POs/Invoices?

Attached is a draft estimate and a one-page SOW for internal review. If the band above is confirmed, I’ll prepare a 3-tier pricing proposal (pay-as-you-go, 3mo commit, 12mo reserve) that maps to the volumes and target $/1M token you asked about.

Next steps:
- Emma to confirm budget band + PO cadence by Wed (3/11)
- Marissa to send tiered pricing and formal estimate after confirmation
- Rishi to be looped in for procurement/legal redlines

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Estimate-Q2.pdf (proposal, 3 pages); SOW-draft-v1.docx (1 page)
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Fowler <ben.fowler@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-03-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call summary + ask: monthly spend band & PO threshold

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear notes and the estimate. Quick responses below: 

- Token volume looks in the right ballpark. Our pilot is scoped ~250–350M tokens/month and we expect to spike toward 500M for marketing bursts; the upper numbers you include make sense.
- Budget band: initial approval for pilot sits at $10k–$20k/mo. If we see the expected engagement lift, leadership is comfortable moving to $30k–$50k/mo for sustained usage with a 3–6 month ramp.
- Procurement: Acme prefers monthly invoices for pilots under $25k/mo. Anything above that requires a monthly PO, and annual POs are only used for large reserved commitments. For legal/terms, procurement asked for a short SOW and an outline of data handling + SOC 2 evidence.

I’ll ask procurement to send the standard vendor onboarding checklist; copying them here. Ben (cc) is aware of the target economics — he wants the pricing that equals roughly $1.00 per 1M tokens at the committed level, with a clear path to lower unit costs if reserve capacity is purchased.

Emma Jones
Director, Growth Product
Acme Health
emma.jones@acmehealth.com

Subject: Vendor onboarding checklist + PO rules

Hello Marissa / Rishi,

Please find Acme Health vendor onboarding requirements below (summary):

1) W-9 and vendor profile completed (we will send our vendor form).
2) Minimum PO threshold: $50,000/month for single PO authorization; below this we will issue monthly invoices with standard 30-day terms.
3) Insurance certificates and SOC 2 Type II attestation (or equivalent evidence).
4) SOW for pilot + acceptance criteria.

We reviewed your attached SOW draft and estimate. Procurement would prefer that any reserved commitment proposals include a clear break-point for unit price reductions (e.g., 3 tiers at 300M, 500M, 1B tokens). Otherwise, invoice + card will work for the pilot.

Please send the W-9, current SOC 2 report, and a version of the SOW with acceptance criteria called out. Once we have those we can issue a vendor profile and proceed with a pilot PO if needed.

Regards,
Procurement Team
procurement@acmehealth.com

Marissa — thanks for driving this. 

High-level approval from my side: pilot funding approved in the $10k–$20k/mo band. If the pilot shows the KPIs we discussed (reduction in triage time and 15% uplift in engagement), we will move to a 3–6 month committed band targeting $30k–$50k/mo. Procurement — the $50k monthly PO threshold is acceptable.

On unit economics: Emma captured it right — target is roughly $1.00 per 1M tokens at the committed level. I expect your pricing tiers to show clear savings at the 500M and 1B token breakpoints.

Marissa, please reply with:
- Finalized tiered quote (paygo / 3mo commit / 12mo reserve) mapped to the token breakpoints
- SOC 2 evidence and W-9 to start vendor onboarding
- Clean SOW with acceptance criteria so we can draft a pilot PO if needed

Best,
Ben Fowler
VP Product, Acme Health
